name: B10-0292/2025 (ESN) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
Mali's military rulers banned all political parties in May 2025. This text is the European Parliament's opinion, not a law. It asks Mali's rulers to talk with political groups about the country's economic and social problems. It asks the African Union to keep engaging with Mali even though Mali's membership is suspended. It asks the European Union to reopen contact with Mali's military rulers and to accept that each side has its own interests and values.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion and requests.
- It concerns Mali's military rulers, the African Union and the European Union.
- Next, the text goes to the Council, the Commission and Mali's military authority.
